title: Supreme Court sends Dr Subbaiah murder case accused to life imprisonment
summary: The trial court had sentenced seven accused, including the father and the two sons, to death for the murder in Agust 2021

title: Supreme Court refuses to recall directions to remove stray dogs from public institutions, warns of contempt for non-compliance
summary: The top court also permitted authorities to undertake euthanasia of “rabid and dangerous dogs” to mitigate threats to human life

title: Karnataka High Court restrains transport unions from resorting to strike on May 20
summary: The court orally noted the Government’s claim that substantial demands of the unions have been already met with by releasing necessary funds

summary: CRPF officer recognised for bravery in Manipur operation that thwarted attack by insurgents on CRPF post

title: Modi in Norway LIVE: PM Modi to meet leaders at the Nordic-India Summit
summary: President of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen once again called for an investment agreement between India and the European Union (EU) as India-EU free trade agreement will be discussed again in the summit

title: For cancer treatment in Telangana, the road still leads to Hyderabad
summary: Hyderabad accounted for 26 cancer-treating hospitals, including 14 government and 12 private facilities; city recorded the highest number of treated cancer patients in Telangana at 12,517

title: Tempo-truck collision in Maharashtra’s Palghar: FIR against both drivers for traffic violations
summary: Heavy traffic on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad Highway, coupled with the tempo driver taking a wrong-side shortcut in violation of traffic rules, led to the fatal crash

title: ACB raids HMWSSB General Manager’s properties, recovers ₹1.05 crore cash during searches
summary: According to officials, five ACB teams began searches from the early hours of Tuesday (May 19, 2026) at properties associated with the accused, including his residence at Mallapur
